lead: Aviation software vendors show steady customer wins and product releases across EFB, flight planning, and dispatch platforms, with Jeppesen and Lufthansa Systems leading in captured marketing and product launch frequency.

insights.title: Royal Air Maroc Selects AvioBook
insights.finding: Royal Air Maroc signed a five-year agreement with Thales to equip its pilots with the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: RAM is a full-service flag carrier deploying modular EFB solutions to streamline cockpit documentation.
insights.caveat: Captured via a LinkedIn announcement; operational rollout timeline was not fully detailed.

insights.title: IFS Secures Multiple EFBWins
insights.finding: IFS secured customer adoptions for its IFS EFBOne platform from fastjet, MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air), and TUS Airways.
insights.aviation_context: fastjet and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) are LCCs, while TUS Airways operates as a hybrid/leisure carrier.
insights.caveat: Announcements highlight software selection and deployment phases rather than fleet-wide operational completion.

insights.title: Jeppesen Expands ForeFlight Capabilities
insights.finding: Jeppesen introduced multiple product enhancements, including ForeFlight FliteDeck Pro v5.3 with Enroute Profile View and the AI-integrated Airflow component.
insights.aviation_context: Aids flight crew situational awareness and flight operation data synthesis.
insights.caveat: Feature releases reflect vendor-reported product updates.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Deploys Lido Flight 4D
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems successfully implemented Lido Flight 4D for Kenya Airways to support flight planning and digital briefing.
insights.aviation_context: Kenya Airways is a major African full-service carrier utilizing integrated flight planning tools.
insights.caveat: Implementation notices document system deployment milestones.

insights.title: Navblue Expands TransNusa Partnership
insights.finding: TransNusa expanded its collaboration with Navblue by adopting Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+.
insights.aviation_context: TransNusa utilizes digital suite integrations to monitor real-time fleet health.
insights.caveat: Captured via vendor announcements regarding regional airline expansion.
